answer_result.answer: Dave finds restoring old cars satisfying because it is like bringing something back to life: he enjoys seeing a car transform from broken-down or beat-up into something beautiful or high-running, seeing the hard work pay off, and feeling a sense of accomplishment, pride, and fulfillment. He also describes it as therapeutic and relaxing, an outlet for self-expression and escape from everyday stress, a way to give an old car new life, and a way to make a difference or help people. He also valued restoring a car with his dad and seeing the end result together.
